replying_to: Replying to MetaEvo: A Meta-Optimization Framework for Experience-Driven Agent Evolution

withdrawal_confirmation.value: I have read and agree with the venue's withdrawal policy on behalf of myself and my co-authors.

comment.value: I would like to formally withdraw my submission titled "MetaEvo: A Meta-Optimization Framework for Experience-Driven Agent Evolution" from the ICLR 2026 conference. After careful consideration and discussions with my co-authors, we have agreed that the submission requires further refinement and preparation to meet the high standards required for this venue. We would like to take additional time to improve the quality of the work before resubmitting it in the future.
